verdict.rationale: Reader lets you forward session cookies on each request via the `X-Set-Cookie` header, so you can reach authenticated pages by resending login cookies every time. Nothing in the evidence shows a persistent browser profile or server-side session that keeps cookies and login state across requests; the S3 and 5-minute caches store fetched page content, not browser state. Missing for 10: a persistent or reusable browser profile, server-side cookie and login-state storage across requests, profile management docs, and hands-on corroboration that authenticated fetching works.
